verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is one first-party line about granular package permissions, including container images and tags. That implies Bitbucket hosts packages and container images, but it does not describe publishing or consuming them. Missing for 10: documented publish/consume workflows, support for named formats like npm, PyPI and Maven, public versus private package visibility, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish and consume public or private packages and container images in many formats such as npm, PyPI, and Maven

citations.quote: define granular branch‑level, environment‑level, and package permissions — including container images and tags
